name: calculate
arguments_raw: {"expression":"A=21; e_ann=6.25; t=36; g=0.025; base_m=A/12; y2=base_m*(1+g); y3=y2*(1+g); sum_face=12*(base_m+y2+y3); e_m=e_ann/12; sum_exp=t*e_m; net_before_ti=sum_face-sum_exp; ti=12; net_total=net_before_ti-ti; eff_annual=(net_total/t)*12; [sum_face, sum_exp, net_before_ti, net_total, eff_annual]"}
